item: President of the Association des maires ruraux de France (AMRF)
detail: Recorded in his HATVP interests declaration as an unpaid (volunteer) function. National presidency of the AMRF, the body representing rural mayors, held until entry into government in 2025.

item: Mayor of Les Voivres (elected local mandate)
detail: Elected mandate as mayor of Les Voivres declared among his elected functions. Mayoral allowances in a commune of around 280 inhabitants are modest, set by statutory scales.

item: Vice-president of the Agence nationale de la cohésion des territoires (ANCT)
detail: Vice-presidency of the ANCT board, held until entry into government in 2025.

item: Vice-president of the Communauté d'agglomération d'Épinal
detail: Vice-president of the Épinal agglomeration community responsible for territorial cohesion, rurality and shared services.
